name: A visitor's page worked from the console, to put its owl somewhere it cannot walk
environment: this machine: the park under wrangler dev on port 8797, the stand-in store on port 8791
hypothesis: Whatever a page sends from its console, the other visitors never see its owl off the floor or standing in mid-air, the room logs what it would not take (position_rejected), and a page that keeps asking for walks out of the room is closed (OP-149).
blast_radius: Three extra scripted visitors in the throwaway park's hub, one at a time, for half a minute.
abort_rule: Any steady-state check failing for more than 30 s during the experiment ends it and runs the rollback; the harness never leaves a fault injected.

observations.what: places the fleet was told the console's owls are at or walking to
observations.fix: walk each target from where the room has the owl, on its own floor (Room.ts move), and tell the others only that walk

observations.what: standing in mid-air told to the fleet
observations.fix: drop a stance up on a perch where no perch that high is near the owl (Room.ts air, perchFor)

observations.what: the page that asked for walks out of the room
observations.fix: drop a walk to a point outside the room and strike it like a burst of moves (Room.ts move)

observations.what: where the hub let in a page that said it was at its far end
observations.value: 185 px from the spawn, 2147 px from where it said
observations.fix: take a hello’s place only near the spawn or near where the owl left lately (Room.ts join)
refuse a frame with a point outside the biggest room as malformed (packages/shared edge.ts parseClientFrame)
